intro.h2: The tile installer is the owner
paragraphs: JMR Tile & Stone is an Inland Empire tile contractor run by Justin Reynaga, who is both the owner and the person setting your tile. He has more than 25 years of experience with showers, tub surrounds, floors and full bathroom remodels.

What reviewers notice is how he runs a job. He helps with decisions along the way, checks in with updates, and stays on budget and on the timeline he gives. One family's 5-day living and dining room tile job was kept clean the whole time. A Lake Arrowhead realtor sends clients his way. Another says they will recommend him and use him again for their next tile project.

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: Custom tile showers with recessed niches, built-in benches, corner shelves and mosaic accent bands. Justin helps you choose tile and layout, then sets it himself. One customer said their new shower looks great and the job stayed on budget and on time.

image.alt: Tiled walk-in shower with large beige porcelain tile, glass mosaic accent band, corner shelves and built-in bench

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Complete bathroom remodels from the shower walls to the floor. A family referred by their realtor in Lake Arrowhead hired JMR for a full bathroom and said the quality of work and communication were excellent throughout, with clear updates on any changes.

image.alt: White subway tile shower with two recessed niches and pebble mosaic floor

items.name: Tub surrounds
items.blurb: Tile tub surrounds that turn a plain tub into a finished bath, such as warm beige tile with a glass mosaic accent row and a grab bar for safety. The work is done with the attention to detail reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Bathtub surround in beige ceramic tile with a dark glass mosaic accent band and chrome grab bars

items.name: Tile floors and backsplashes
items.blurb: Wood-look tile planks for living and dining rooms, plus kitchen backsplashes. One homeowner chose a wood-look tile, and Justin worked out a pattern that complemented the tile already in the house. The floor took five days and the house stayed clean.

image.alt: Gray-brown wood-look porcelain plank tile floor in a living and dining room

items.title: On budget, on schedule
items.text: Two Google reviewers say Justin stayed within their budget, and one adds that he finished in the timeline he gave. Budget adherence is a recurring review topic.

items.title: Attention to detail
items.text: Attention to detail is the top topic in JMR's Google reviews. You see it in lined-up mosaic bands, tidy niches and floor patterns matched to existing tile.

items.title: Help with every decision
items.text: Customers call Justin very knowledgeable. He helps pick tile and patterns, checks in with updates, and explains any change clearly before it happens.

items.title: Licensed, bonded, insured
items.text: JMR Tile & Stone states it is licensed, bonded and insured, and Justin brings more than 25 years of tile experience to every job.

about.text: Justin Reynaga is the owner and tile installer behind JMR Tile & Stone. He has more than 25 years of experience and runs a licensed, bonded and insured business serving the Inland Empire. His promise on Instagram is simple: quality work and exceptional customer service. Customers say he is easy to work with, keeps the house clean and stays in touch through the whole job. One customer says she will definitely use him again for her next tile project, and one family came to him on their realtor's recommendation.

image.alt: JMR Tile & Stone business card with red and chrome shield logo featuring a tile trowel

process.h2: How a tile job with JMR works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (951) 823-9939, any day from 9 AM to 5 PM, or email or message Justin on Instagram with photos.

steps.title: Choose tile together
steps.text: Justin walks you through tile, patterns and layout and helps with each decision, including matching existing tile.

steps.title: Budget and timeline
steps.text: You agree on a budget and a timeline up front. Reviewers say Justin stayed within both on their jobs.

steps.title: Install and updates
steps.text: Justin sets the tile himself, keeps the house clean, and checks in with updates and any changes as the job moves along.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Look over the finished shower or floor with Justin and make sure every detail is the way you want it.

items.name: Stephanie C.
items.text: Justin came highly recommended from our realtor in Lake Arrowhead. We hired JMR Tile and Stone for a full bathroom remodel and are absolutely thrilled with the results. The quality of work and communication were both excellent throughout the entire process. Justin often checked in with us informing us of any updates and changes with clear communication and was able to stay within our budget. We are beyond thankful we chose JMR!

items.name: Londa G.
items.text: What an absolutely incredible job Justin did with our living/dining room tile. We chose a tile that looks like wood and he helped to compliment the existing tile with this updated pattern. The house was kept clean during the 5 day long job and we couldn’t be happier with the finished job.  We will recommend him to others and definitely use again for our next tile project.

items.name: Caroline W.
items.text: Justin was great to work with. He is very knowledgeable and helped us along the way with all the decisions. Stayed on budget and in the provided timeline. Our new shower looks great and we couldn’t be happier.

service_area.h2: Inland Empire tile contractor, coming to your home
service_area.text: JMR Tile & Stone serves homeowners across the Inland Empire of Southern California, the area named in Justin's Instagram profile. Reviewers include a family who found him through their realtor in Lake Arrowhead. There is no public shop address, since the work happens at your home. Call (951) 823-9939 with your city to confirm he can take on your project.

items.a: Yes. JMR Tile & Stone's Instagram profile states that the business is licensed, bonded and insured, and that owner Justin Reynaga has more than 25 years of experience. Ask Justin for his licence number and insurance details when you call, and he can share them before work starts.

Justin does. He is listed as both the owner and the tile installer, so the person who helps you choose tile and plan the layout is the same person setting it. Reviewers mention him by name for the quality of the work and his communication.

Agree on the budget and timeline with Justin before work starts. Two Google reviewers say he stayed within their budget, and one says he also finished in the timeline he gave. He checks in with updates and explains any changes clearly as they come up.

Google lists JMR Tile & Stone as open every day from 9 AM to 5 PM. Call (951) 823-9939, email Justinreynaga@gmail.com, or message @jmr_tile_and_stone on Instagram with photos of the space you want tiled and a rough idea of size.

items.q: Can you match tile I already have?
items.a: Often, yes. One homeowner picked a wood-look tile for her living and dining room, and Justin designed a pattern that complemented the existing tile in the house. Send photos of what you have and he can talk through your options.

final_cta.h2: Planning a new shower or tile floor?
final_cta.text: Call Justin and talk through your tile project.
